items.title: Fake ad blocker extension crashes the browser for ClickFix attacks
items.description: A malvertising campaign is using a fake ad-blocking Chrome and Edge extension named NexShield that intentionally crashes the browser in preparation for ClickFix attacks. [...]

items.title: Remcos RAT Masquerade as VeraCrypt Installers Steals Users Login Credentials
items.description: A sophisticated malware campaign targeting South Korean users has emerged, distributing the Remcos remote access trojan (RAT) through deceptive installers disguised as legitimate VeraCrypt encryption software. This ongoing attack campaign primarily focuses on individuals connected to illegal online gambling platforms, though security experts warn that everyday users downloading encryption tools…
